newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.27 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 473.87 from 475.16 on Thursday.
Volume was 505,575 dinars against 2.27 million dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank dropped 2 dinars to 28 dinars. Retail stores MONOPRIX was down 0.6 dinaro to 30.5. Airliner Tunis Air eased 0.2 dinar to 17.
Banque du Sud gained 0.4 dinar to 26.94. BIAT bank was up 0.38 dinar to 30.5 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecanique du Sahel rose 0.29 dinar to 11.21 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
